question.text: Let the maximum value of $\left(\sin ^{-1} x\right)^{2}+\left(\cos ^{-1} x\right)^{2}$ for $x \in\left[-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right]$ be $\frac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{n}} \pi^{2}$, where $\operatorname{gcd}(\mathrm{m}, \mathrm{n})=1$.
